package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in the provided report. The article discusses macro-level risks, trends, and recommendations regarding software supply chain security, but does not analyze or identify any particular malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected or unauthorized software updates or downloads
Introduction of unknown or unverified third-party dependencies
Execution of code from supply chain components with unclear provenance
Unusual network activity from build or CI/CD environments
file_indicators: Presence of unlisted or undocumented dependencies in SBOMs
Unexpected changes to package manifests (e.g., package.json, requirements.txt)
Unsigned or tampered software update files
network_indicators: Outbound connections to untrusted or previously unseen domains during build or install processes
Unexpected API calls to external services from supply chain components
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unauthorized or unexpected changes in software dependencies and package manifests. Require and verify SBOMs from all suppliers. Implement behavioral monitoring in CI/CD and build environments to detect anomalous network activity or file modifications. Regularly audit and validate the provenance and integrity of all third-party and open-source components used in the software supply chain.
